why:
The briefs handle all four must_catch items.
1. Verifier Check 3 runs `node $CLI $T/good1.jsonl $T/missing.jsonl $T/bad.jsonl` in one command. It expects exit 2, an error on stderr and stdout still reporting `$T/bad.jsonl:2: ...`. That is the missing file and the bad row together, not each alone.
2. Check 4 runs `git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`. It also compares lint output against a worktree at the base commit, so "unchanged" is checked against the diff.
3. Builder step 5 says "Update `packages/jsonl-lint/README.md` to document the usage: several files, `-` for stdin...".
4. Check 6 reads the PR body with `gh pr view` and runs `gh pr checks`. It requires the body to contain the Closes line and the test workflow run for the head commit to have succeeded.
